non_blocking_notes: Deterministic closed-loop validation: JSON list input → sorted uniqueness → allowlist → immutable tuple. All paths reject or proceed completely.
Duplicate coverage added via test case with identical values, addressing prior review gap.
Immutability preserved: tuple conversion only after validation passes, preventing downstream mutation.
result.reasoning_summary: Repair correctly implements JSON list input admission with validation of sorted uniqueness and allowed values, converting to immutable tuple. Narrow patch touches only data_classifications validation and test fixtures. Type enforcement rejects tuple input, sorted order check validates uniqueness and ascending sort in single comparison, allowlist validates against _DATA_CLASSES. Test suite extended with duplicate detection case and unsorted list case, replacing prior tuple-focused tests. No provider access, credential resolution, invocation, deployment, or authority granted. Malformed, duplicate, unsorted, and invalid-value inputs fail closed with HighAssuranceProfileDenied. Security posture maintained: immutable bounded metadata, evidence-first processing, tenant-bound profile binding.
